title: Chocolate Chip Count
shareTitle: Chocolate Chip Count 🍪 — Pop, Catch, and Count with Ravi
description: Pop clay balloons, slide Ravi's baking tray under every falling chocolate chip, and hear the count grow from one to ten in QLOBE Kids' first gentle arcade-style action game.
learningGoals: Count caught objects from 1 to 10 with one spoken number per object
Connect the last spoken number to the total quantity collected
Coordinate horizontal tray movement with a falling object's path
interactionModel: Choose an exact 3, 6, or 10-chip cookie, tap one active balloon at a time, then drag anywhere across the playfield to slide Ravi and his tray under each falling chip. Missed chips bounce back gently until caught; keyboard arrows are supported.
feedbackModel: Each catch adds one visible chip to the progress cookie and speaks the next number. Misses make a playful boing and return without penalty. Completing the exact quantity reveals the finished cookie, three clay stars, confetti, spoken praise, and Again/Next controls.

modes.title: Super Batch
modes.skill: sustained catch counting to 10 across wider space

credits: Kaigani; original claymation assets authored with built-in gpt-image-2 and locally processed for QLOBE Kids. Ravi is the recurring QLOBE Kids cast member.
